item.title: Impact and reach of the IJW (2023 scores update)
item.description: We are pleased to announce that some official impact rates for 2023 are available: Scopus CiteScore = 6.7; SJR = 1.026; SNIP 1.290. These results put the IJW in the top quartile for many of the disciplinary categories we occupy. Our own analysis reveals an average of 76 citations per article from the 210 articles we have published in the period 2011-2022 (Google Scholar). Readers from all over the world have viewed our articles over 1.5 million times. Full-text downloads for 2021 were 172,492. S
